summary: Scans up to 8 physics channels (23-float / 0x5C-byte stride) starting at this+36 (0x90 bytes). A channel is active when its first float is greater than 0.0. Returns the flat channel index (0-7) of the (a2+1)-th active channel (a2 zero-based). Returns 0 if fewer than a2+1 active channels exist.

operations.description: Initialize counters v2 (active-channel count) and v3 (flat channel index) to 0.
Iterate the channel array: i starts at this+36 and advances by 23 floats per step, for at most 8 channels.
While the channel's first float *i is <= 0.0 (inactive), advance to the next channel index; a channel with *i > 0.0 is active and stops the scan advance.
Bound the scan at 8 channels: when the incremented index v3 reaches 8, return 0 (not found).
When an active channel is found but it is not yet the a2-th, increment the active-channel count v2 and continue scanning.
Return the flat channel index v3 when the a2-th active channel (a2 == v2) is located; otherwise return 0 after exhausting the 8-channel bound.
